Queen Victoria made her own war honour... with a crochet hook!
It's 1900. Britain is fighting the Boer War in South Africa.
The queen is eighty years old. She crochets eight khaki scarves.
Each one carries her royal mark. V. R. I.
Officers pick the bravest private soldiers, from Britain, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa.
Would you rather win a medal... or the Queen's scarf?
